message: Build a static mobile-friendly index.html reading-list page for a fictional neighborhood book club. Show six sample books with author and short description, filter by fiction/nonfiction/all and a clear empty state. Add a next-meeting block with fictional location. Inline CSS/JS, no network or build step. Labels, keyboard controls and visible focus matter.

profile.sections: use the sections in the brief
profile.platform: local Windows and Python 3 stdlib for CLI; modern desktop/mobile browser for web
profile.defaults: Smallest solution described; no accounts, network, deployment or paid assets. Ask before scope or budget changes.
